jobs.description:
Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Responsibilities
 
 

• Study, specification, design and verification of high-quality digital and mixed-signal ICs 

• Write digital specifications for mixed-signal ICs, make area and power estimations 

• Technical team lead for the digital content of mixed-signal ASICs including interaction with customers, suppliers and the internal ASIC development team 

• Lead, attend and present at project/review meetings worldwide 

• Coach junior engineers in design, verification and testing of integrated circuits and improve their level of technical expertise and knowledge of the total business 

• Work together with international customers and communicate efficiently to successfully complete the project 

• Write documentation 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer with at least four years of experience in digital IC design 

• You have experience with front-end ASIC or FPGA design in VHDL and/or Verilog and/or SystemVerilog 

• You have experience with front-end verification, preferably in SystemVerilog + UVM, to write directed tests, constrained randomized tests and to gather and interpret metrics such as code/condition/FSM/toggle/functional coverage 

• You have experience with digital synthesis, logic equivalence checking (LEC) and Static Timing Analysis (STA) 

• Experience with UPF and/or CPF and DFT and ATPG is a plus 

• Experience with scripting and programming languages such as Python and C is a plus 

• Experience with any of the following protocols and techniques is a plus: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, LIN, SENT, DSP, CRC, FSM design, MCU 

• You are a self-motivated, efficient professional able to work alone or in teams 

• You offer quality and reliability to colleagues, customers and management, willing to share knowledge and able to communicate efficiently 

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

As the Business Partner – HR & WFM, you will act as the key bridge between local business domains and TDDI by capturing business needs, translating them into IT requirements, and connecting with regional TDDI to deliver effective solutions. You align IT initiatives with business priorities, fosters strong stakeholder relationships, and ensures that IT investments generate measurable business value. 

•

• 

Contribute to the business domain and TDDI roadmap by gathering business needs, including cost and budget considerations, and aligning them with the relevant TDDI solution centers. 

• 

Act as a local demand or portfolio manager within the TDDI Demand Management process by clarifying business demand, ensuring alignment with TDDI policies and guidelines, and facilitating the approval of local or cluster initiatives with the appropriate experts. 

• 

Serve as a local ambassador for TDDI transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment between regional objectives and the needs of one or more business domains. 

• 

Bridge regional, cluster, or country business requirements with TDDI’s technical capabilities and services. 

• 

Coordinate change delivery, major incident management, temporary fixes, and workarounds for applications and systems within the Application domain at global, regional, and local levels. 

• 

Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers operating within the scope of the Application domain. 

• 

Monitor KPIs and performance dashboards for local solutions to ensure service quality and drive continuous improvement. 

• 

Solid understanding of one or more Sodexo business and application domains  

• 

Familiarity with support tier structures and vendor coordination  

• 

Knowledge of product management concepts  

• 

Ability to work independently and coordinate with remote teams  

• 

Ability to distinguish presented user requests from underlying true needs, and distinguish solution ideas from requirements  

• 

Strong communication in both English and the local languages as well as stakeholder management skills

Job description 

Transport of mainly sea containers in and around the port of Antwerp or Rotterdam during the night shift.

Occasionally also trailer exchange work with tarpaulin (Bache) to destinations such as Leuven or Liège.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a DIAGNOSIC TECHNICIAN.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a diagnosic technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;
  • Establishing diagnoses and setting up diagnostic equipment;
  • Carrying out repairs and replacing parts;
  • Working on passenger cars, vans and trucks (depending on experience and skills);
  • Performing maintenance work;

As a diagnosic Technician in the Veurne region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You already have a basic knowledge of automotive technology;
  • You are a motivated technician with a passion for technology;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?

Job description 

For a large transport company, you will be working in their distribution center, moving trailers from the parking area to the loading docks and vice versa. You will do this using a Terberg (terminal tractor), a machine specifically designed for this task.

You will communicate via onboard radio with the planning team, who will assign your tasks. For smooth communication, a good knowledge of Dutch or English is required.

There are different shifts: from 04:00 to 14:00, from 05:00 to 17:00, or from 14:00 to 22:00.

A C/CE driving license is required, but Code 95 is not necessary.

 Requirements 

    
• C/CE driving license
    
• Good parking skills with tractor-trailer
    
• Sense of responsibility and focus on safety
    
• Ability to handle stress
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.

Are you up to the challenge?

Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
• Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment. 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime. 
• You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
• You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
• You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role. 
• You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
 
• You have technical training or equivalent experience. 
• You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology. 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
• You have a proactive attitude. 
• You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently. 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success. 
• You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages. 
• You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job
    
• Work from Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays in consultation

• More working hours = higher salary

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license
    
• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English
    
• Departure from Merksem

We're on the lookout for a 
Mid-Level AI Systems Engineer who bridges AI engineering and MLOps. Someone who loves getting hands-on with LLMs, agents, and RAG pipelines, and who cares just as much about what happens once a model reaches production as about building it in the first place. In this role, you'll design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems, with a strong focus on generative AI, LLM-based applications, and reliable machine learning operations. In practice your time is split roughly between 60-70% AI Engineering and 30-40% MLOps.
 

In this role you sit at the intersection of engineering and operations, working across teams and disciplines. You'll report to the Head of ML at Sagacify and collaborate with the wider Sagacify and Craftzing delivery organisation. A role that can naturally grow towards a Team Lead position over time.
 

What you'll do :
 

AI Engineering (60-70%)
 
 

• Orchestrate AI system components: LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers, and user interfaces 

• Develop autonomous agents and conversational systems that can plan actions and interact with external tools or APIs 

• Build and optimise RAG pipelines connecting enterprise data sources to LLMs for grounded, contextualised, reliable answers 

• Evaluate system quality through generative AI metrics, coherence tests, and production monitoring (latency, API costs, bias) 

• Deploy and scale solutions with strong attention to latency, security, reliability and cost efficiency 

• Keep an eye on the ecosystem for new models, frameworks and techniques, including open-source tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, etc. 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality, reduce hallucinations, and manage conversational state effectively  

MLOps (30-40%)
 
 

• Build and maintain automation for model deployment, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing 

• Continuously monitor model performance in production, including drift detection and quality metric tracking 

• Manage updates of libraries, models, and related dependencies in production environments 

• Ensure versioning, reproducibility and safe rollout of models and AI services 

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers, developers, DevOps and infrastructure teams for smooth delivery 

• Stay current with the latest MLOps practices, tools and platform components  

You stay in the code, you stay curious about what happens after deployment, and you keep learning as you go.

 

• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, attention mechanisms, generation parameters and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and algorithmic creativity 

• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You bring rigour, responsiveness and a good incident-handling mindset 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English and French, or at least the first two languages  

Don’t worry if you don’t tick every single box, what matters most is the right mindset and a drive to learn. If you think we’re a match, we’d love to hear from you.

For an international player in the industrial sector, we are looking for an experienced 
Freelance Payroll Specialist to temporarily strengthen the internal payroll team. In this role, you will report directly to the Payroll Manager.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• Supporting the end-to-end payroll cycle for approximately 400 employees (blue- and white-collar) in collaboration with SD Worx. 

• Ensuring the 
accuracy, completeness and timeliness of data in SD Worx and SAP SuccessFactors. 

• Monitoring, analyzing and optimizing the 
time and attendance system. 

• Identifying and analyzing anomalies within payroll processes and system configurations while contributing to sustainable solutions. 

• Initiating and implementing 
process improvements with a strong focus on efficiency, quality and automation. 

Your profile:
 
 

• Proven experience with end-to-end payroll processing, time and attendance systems and payroll process optimization within a complex organization. 

• Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. 

• Experience with SAP SuccessFactors and/or within an industrial manufacturing environment is considered an asset. 

• Solid knowledge of Belgian social legislation and payroll regulations. 

• Fluent in French and English. 

• A proactive, hands-on and service-oriented mindset.

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.

• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

Our client, located in Veurne, has been an established name within the transport sector for many years.

This family-owned company has grown over the years into a strong player with an extensive fleet and a professional logistics operation.

For their yard, they are looking for a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER who will be responsible for loading and unloading trucks and containers.

Your responsibilities as a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER in the Veurne region include:

  • Operating a mobile crane for loading and unloading trucks and containers;
  • Moving materials and goods;
  • Loading and unloading containers in a safe and efficient manner;
  • Checking the correct operation of the crane and equipment;
  • Ensuring a safe and clean working environment on the yard;
  • Working closely with drivers and colleagues within the logistics operation.
As a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER in the Veurne region, we are looking for someone who meets the following requirements:

  • Experience operating a mobile crane;
  • Technical insight and the ability to work safely with machinery;
  • You work accurately and independently;
  • You are responsible and have a strong focus on safety;
  • You speak Dutch, English, or French;
  • Physical work does not scare you.

Do you enjoy working outdoors and take pride in creating beautiful terraces, driveways, and garden paths?

For a family-run landscaping company in the Koekelare region, we are looking for a FLOORER who delivers high-quality outdoor projects with great attention to detail.

Your responsibilities as a FLOORER in KOEKELARE:

  • Installing terraces, driveways, and garden paths;
  • Laying paving stones, natural stone, ceramic tiles, and other types of outdoor paving;
  • Preparing and levelling the ground;
  • Installing kerbstones, edging, and finishing materials;
  • Working with a variety of machines and hand tools;
  • Collaborating with colleagues on complete landscaping projects.



As a FLOORER in the Koekelare region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience installing terraces, driveways, or other types of outdoor paving;
  • You work accurately and have an eye for high-quality finishing;
  • You are willing to work outdoors;
  • Basic knowledge of plants and an affinity with greenery and landscaping are a plus;
  • You speak Dutch OR English.
